title: RTPS: Add dedicated filter fields for sequence numbers and fix field labels
description:
Previously, many distinct sequence number fields across different RTPS
submessages shared the single filter identifier rtps.sm.seqNumber, making
it impossible to filter on a specific field of a specific submessage. For
example, HEARTBEAT's firstAvailableSeqNumber and lastSeqNumber both used
rtps.sm.seqNumber, preventing filters like
"rtps.heartbeat.lastSeqNumber > rtps.heartbeat.firstAvailableSeqNumber".

Add an hf_item parameter to rtps_util_add_seq_number so each call site
specifies its own registered field. Register dedicated fields for
HEARTBEAT (rtps.heartbeat.firstAvailableSeqNumber, lastSeqNumber),
HEARTBEAT_BATCH (rtps.heartbeat_batch.firstSN, lastSN, firstVirtualSN,
lastVirtualSN), TypeLookup (rtps.type_lookup.* GUID prefix, sequence
number, type hash), and PID_DIRECTED_WRITE (rtps.directed_write.*).
Submessages that don't need their own fields continue to use
rtps.sm.seqNumber.

Also split hf_rtps_type_lookup_discriminator into separate request and
reply variants for independent filtering.

Fix HEARTBEAT_BATCH/SESSION field names to match the RTI Connext wire
protocol: firstBatchSN/lastBatchSN are renamed to firstSN/lastSN, and
firstSeqNumber/lastSeqNumber to firstVirtualSN/lastVirtualSN.

Fix rtps_util_add_timestamp_sec_and_fraction which hardcoded the label
"lease_duration" for all QoS duration fields. Now derives the label from
the registered hf field name via proto_registrar_get_nth().

AI-Assisted: yes (GitHub Copilot, Claude)
